title: Hidrismos
description: This mod adds armor, swords, tools,dimensions,structures,
body:
This mod does not have a specific theme, and I included everything that came to mind.
The result was cool, so I decided to post it, but it adds very powerful items with armor, many swords, tools, 3 dimensions,
a sculk dimension that has nothing,
many structures, recipes, 3 professional villagers, and 4 new minerals. With the miner villager at Master, there is an exchange:
2 packs of netherite blocks for one koji
and another 2 packs of koji for one chromium
screp in the caves
there is platinum and gralititi
along with these 2 minerals, you will receive
a sword and a very strong pickaxe There is also an explorer villager
who has very good trades and work mass
and a shuker box
and a miner and a furnace. and the lick pickaxe
broken bad rock
a block appears
and with this block
it is a barrier block that can be crafted
you can go to the void dimension
and there is a strong mob that drops
voidite which is used to make certain items the enchanted eyes
I can take chromatic armor to another level Op Land is a dimension where you can find all the structures in the game and a very difficult dungeon
that has the Titan sword. It also provides a useful tool for the sniffer, and you go to Op Land for a chest and a mod that you will enjoy. This is my first mod, so feedback is important. 
 Credits to SmaFaithful for the texture of the koji and chromic items and the enchat eya. 
Download it, go on an adventure, and have fun!
